title: Wait
description: Adds a dialog to skip time up to 24 hours
body:
**Pressing G** will open the "Wait" dialog which lets you choose up to 24 hours of time you would like to skip forward.

Find a button to this dialog in the escape menu.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/PbiHGRPS22s" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>



Bring up the menu with

/trigger wait

Skip up to 24 hours of time with

/trigger wait_function set <1-24>

**Supports Minecraft versions 1.21.6-26.1.2**

_No need for cheats to be enabled for this to work_
